children: Drilling Tools International and subsidiary Casing Technologies Group amended their share purchase agreement to give the buyer more flexibility to finance its proposed acquisition of Saltire Energy and Foxley Energy. The buyer may pursue the agreed financing terms and alternative debt or equity financing concurrently, provided funding covers the adjusted cash consideration and transaction costs without increasing the sellers' obligations or reducing their rights. The amendment also delays the date when sellers may initiate financing discussions to January 15, 2027, and limits their termination right to specified conditions.
: Saltire Energy, Foxley Energy, the sellers, and Jack William Loggie as seller representative
